desc: The SUGAR WEASELis a direct impingement pistol. Its built on clear anodized M-16 spec receiver set (no forward assist), and features the same fast-twist barrel, Cherry Bomb muzzle brake, adjustable gas block, and M-LOK hand-guard as the higher priced Honey Badger. It uses a 6-position receiver extension that houses a carbine length action spring and buffer, and is topped off with a custom grey SB Tactical SBA3 Pistol Stabilizing Brace (PSB).
